SHEET_NAMES , NVL(R.SEL010_YN, 'N') AS SEL010_YN , NVL(R.SEL020_YN, 'N') AS SEL020_YN , 'N' AS SEL030_YN , NVL(R.SEL040_YN, 'N') AS SEL040_YN , NVL(R.SEL050_YN, 'N') AS SEL050_YN , NVL(R.SEL055_YN, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD != '030' AND NVL(TRIM(Z.GOV_SUB),'') != '' THEN Z.GOV_SUB ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS GOV_SUB , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '010' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS A.FIS_YEAR AND F.BGT_DGR (+) = A.BGT_DGR AND F.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID (+) = A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USERDEPT Z WHERE Z.USER_ID = #userId# AND Z.DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD AND Z.USE_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1)
AND D.FIS_FG_MST_CD = #fisFgMstCd# AND D.FIS_FG_CD = #fisFgCd# AND B.OFFICE_CD = #officeCd# AND B.DEPT_RANK >= #deptRankFr# AND B.DEPT_RANK <= #deptRankTo# AND A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD >= #teMngMokCdFr# AND A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD <= #teMngMokCdTo#
